item.title: Photostory: Ole Miss outlasts Georgia 39–34 in thrilling Sugar Bowl finish
item.description: Ole Miss closed the 2026 Sugar Bowl with a dramatic final minute, edging Georgia 39–34 on Thursday night at Caesars Superdome in a game that swung repeatedly and wasn’t decided until the final seconds. item.title: Brown Bag History Lecture Series returns to Augusta Museum of History
item.description: The Augusta Museum of History has announced its 2026 Brown Bag History Lecture Series. item.title: Revised SPLOST 9 list headed for vote
item.description: The Augusta Commission is set to vote Tuesday on a revised $325.7 million SPLOST 9 package after a smaller proposal drew criticism from commissioners and department heads. The post Revised SPLOST 9 list headed for vote appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Woman shot Friday afternoon in Augusta; suspect in custody
item.description: A woman was shot Friday afternoon on Butler Manor Drive and Morgan Road in Augusta, authorities said. Richmond County authorities responded to the shooting at 1:16 p.m., where the woman was suffering from more than one gunshot wounds.
